_comment_for_humans: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint -- Custom Indicators (TI Indicators API)
Each object below is one POST body for:
1. URL indicator    -- blocks GitHub repo path. Zero FP risk.
2. File hashes      -- only useful if you have specific samples.
3. Filename pattern -- not natively supported; use a SmartScreen
NAIVE v1: Block 'github.com' entirely. Org breaks instantly.
HARDENED v2: Block the SPECIFIC PATH /iss4cf0ng/OpenPetya only.
SmartScreen URL category 'malware' filter handles the
rest. URL-path-specific blocks are a no-FP control.

indicators_to_post.title: Block OpenPetya repository delivery
indicators_to_post.description: Source repository for Petya-class educational PoC ransomware.
indicators_to_post.recommendedActions: Investigate any host that reached this URL. Search prior 30 days of DeviceFileEvents/DeviceProcessEvents for OpenPetya artifacts.
indicators_to_post._tightening_notes: Path-scoped URL block. Does not affect other github.com use. Cannot be defeated by URL renaming on attacker side (would require forking and changing the path; detection script in companion .kql checks for any /iss4cf0ng/ path).

indicators_to_post.title: Block OpenPetya raw-file delivery from GitHub CDN
indicators_to_post.description: GitHub raw content URL for the OpenPetya repository.

indicators_to_post.title: Block OpenPetya zip-archive delivery from GitHub

indicators_to_post._block_named_artifact_with_certificate_a: FileSha256 indicators below are placeholders. Replace with hashes of samples you collect. Hash-based blocking is brittle (recompile defeats) but useful for known artifacts. The behavioral prevention (ASR + IOAs) carries the load; hashes are a supplement.
indicators_to_post.title: Block known OpenPetya.exe sample (PLACEHOLDER)
indicators_to_post.description: Replace value with actual SHA-256 of collected sample.
indicators_to_post._tightening_notes: Hash blocks are point-in-time. Pair with ASR rule 01443614-cd74-433a-b99e-2ecdc07bfc25 (block low-prevalence binaries) for durable coverage.
